profile.name: Agustinus Ardhito Vedoputro
profile.title: Engineering Manager | Distributed Systems & Platform Reliability
profile.summary: Engineering Manager with 9+ years of software engineering experience and 5+ years leading engineering teams. Combines hands-on expertise in software architecture, system design, and coding with a track record of building complex distributed and event-driven systems using technologies such as Kafka and Redis. Experienced in scaling highly reliable platforms to millions of users, developing high-performing teams, and shaping technical strategy for business-critical HRIS and public-sector applications.

keyAchievements: Mekari Talenta: Led the migration of payroll disbursement services from a monolith to microservices, reducing processing time from 30 minutes to 2.5 minutes and addressing single points of failure.
GovTechEdu: Built a public-sector data visualization platform using modern engineering practices, serving 500,000+ schools and 5+ million users across Indonesia.
Bukalapak: Scaled systems supporting 5+ million daily active users and 10,000+ requests per second while maintaining 99.99% uptime.

experiences.summary: Lead and develop a 10-person team comprising backend engineers, frontend engineers, and a solutions engineer. Drive performance, reliability, and delivery for Mekari Talenta's HRIS platform, which serves 50,000+ B2B customers and integrates with external partners.
achievements: Introduced AI-assisted development workflows using Claude, ChatGPT, and GitHub Copilot, reducing selected delivery cycles from two weeks to four days while establishing governance to maintain production quality.
Led the AI-assisted development of a Learning Management System, delivering it in four months after the previous approach had remained incomplete for 18 months.
Led the re-architecture of financial and payroll disbursement systems, reducing processing time from 30 minutes to 2.5 minutes.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Data, Security, QA, Commercial, and Technical Support teams, while coordinating with external partners.
Lead incident response and reliability improvements through automation, alerting, monitoring, and testing with Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, and Playwright.

experiences.summary: Led and developed a team of 10+ architects, backend engineers, and frontend engineers responsible for building and operating a data visualization platform in collaboration with multiple government institutions.
achievements: Led the development of a highly available data visualization platform serving 500,000+ schools and 5+ million users, supported by Grafana and Prometheus.

Drove technical strategy and architecture decisions in alignment with stakeholders across multiple government institutions.
Improved team delivery through Scrum process optimization and individual mentoring.
Introduced engineering best practices for government platforms, including automated testing, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform.

experiences.summary: Led and developed a cross-functional team of 7+ backend, frontend, Android, and iOS engineers.
achievements: Led architecture and system design for a mature, distributed SaaS and PaaS platform serving 5+ million daily active users.
